faultproc.title: HELMET TROUBLESHOOTING PROCEDURES

step1.para: Inspect retention assembly for defective hardware or webbing.
Replace retention assembly in accordance with Retention Assembly.

faultproc.symptom: UNABLE TO KEEP MICROPHONE IN POSITION.

step1.para: Inspect boom, microphone assembly for loose screw
If unable to tighten screw, replace in accordance with .

faultproc.title: COMMUNICATIONS
faultproc.malfunc: Communications cord unplugged or communication unit not working.

step1.para: Ensure that communications cord is plugged into communication unit and that unit is working. Ensure helmet connector on left rear side of helmet is secured.
If still unable to hear, perform continuity check as follows:

step2.para: Using a multimeter (AN/URM-105 C or equivalent), perform in accordance with the appropriate action for your communication system (standard or TEMPEST).

step3.para: If no failure detected, proceed to .
If a failure is detected, replace the communication cord in accordance with Communications System. Proceed to .
